What is the total number of wickets?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38ccad95286e5f7b3d51699c4f0b48607f8e1b99ce7c91d9e45be7cec67c5fd7.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8452c1923d23873edc2cc7dc6a0168aa616a50ac2d7af50df768c589acf9c61.png] 

The total number of wickets are = (16 + 8 + 13 + 4) = 41

Hence, the correct answer is **" 41 "**.
